items.text: The best courses for school students are the ones that match a clear purpose, such as exploring a field or building one basic skill, without crowding out school study, so choose by purpose first, try free options second and pay last.
Then match a course to it and keep school marks safe.
Ask who teaches the course, what you will finish and what the refund terms are, in writing, before you pay.
